warnings: All bars print ø -> type RB (sections 0.6/6). No concrete strength, steel grade or cover is printed on this sheet.

Footing thickness: the section chain prints 0.20 at the footing edge plus 0.05 where the top slopes up to the pedestal; height_mm = 250 (edge + slope, same reading as house 157), both parts kept in height_mm_printed_as. The 1.20 chain runs from ระดับดินเดิม to the footing underside; below it 0.05 lean concrete 1:3:5 and 0.10 compacted coarse sand (ทรายหยาบรองพื้น).

F1 is rectangular (1.30 x 1.80, 12 piles in 3 x 4) — depth_mm carries the long side; F2 is square (1.30, 9 piles). Mats are two-way at one printed spacing (ø12 @0.15# / ø9 @0.10#); no bar count is printed, so main_bar has spacing, not count (section 6b).
Columns: C1 0.25x0.25 'จากฐานราก ถึง หลังคา', C2 0.20x0.20 'จากฐานราก ถึง ระเบียง' — one entry each, the printed run kept in level (section 8).
